name: Cry Baby GCB95

dims.source: Thomann GCB95 listing (W x D x H) 102 x 254 x 64 mm, corroborated by Dunlop retailer listings 10 x 4 x 2-1/2 in: footprint 4.02 x 10.00 in is published; the published 64 mm (2.52 in) height is the treadle-level nominal and matches the measured treadle-top height over the heel/pivot (2.50 in), so h here is the measured toe-raised rest height of the bare shell+treadle (3.00 in, rubber pad and feet excluded) from references/dunlop-crybaby-gcb95_measurements.md

enclosure.notes: Base casting only (the wah shell lower half), traced from both Dunlop side views calibrated at 104.5 px/in against the published 10.00 in depth, y=0 at the base plate (feet excluded). The moving treadle and rubber pad are treadleProfile / padProfile below, DS-1 pattern. See references/dunlop-crybaby-gcb95_measurements.md. Constant-width extrusion: the real shell tapers 3.96 in (toe) to 3.18 in (heel) in plan; that taper needs the proposed tapered wah builder in the build report.

treadleProfile.note: Moving treadle casting at rest (toe raised), traced from both side views (see measurements). Polygon: heel-top, toe-top, toe face bottom (0.65 in face), underside skirt line through mid, heel-bottom. The underside is hollow in the real casting, but the side skirt bottom is this line — a recessed underside profile made the treadle read as a thin floating slab in Side view (checked against the references, corrected 2026-10-24). Width is a mid-taper compromise (real casting tapers with the shell). Pivot for the hero press: z -2.10, y 1.70 (pivot field below).

padProfile.note: Ribbed rubber pad on the treadle top (treadle top line + ~0.13 in). Ribs and the embossed AMPLIFIER / INSTRUMENT groove words are the padDecal texture, not geometry.

pivot.note: Treadle pivot axis from the silver side pins in both side views (left z -1.99, right z -2.35 after mirroring; average). Used by the hero page to rotate the whole moving set (treadle + pad + pad decal + pivot pins) toe-down on a press. Not read by parts.js yet: proposed spec field, see build report.

footswitch.note: Toe switch under the treadle toe (chrome plunger in the Dunlop MAIN and Sweetwater detail toe views), seated on the base profile at its z (deck part: no y in spec). It stays fixed on a treadle press; the treadle dips toward it.

jacks.note: AMPLIFIER (output) on the left wall, from the left side view + top view hole.
INSTRUMENT (input) on the right wall, from the right side view + top view; spec z is the two sides' average (left 0.55, right 0.60).

sidePowerJack.note: Proposed spec field (parts.js powerJack() only mounts on the back wall; the GCB95 DC 9V barrel is on the right wall just heel-ward of the INSTRUMENT jack, right side view + 3/4, provisional). The hero page renders it from this field; board integration needs the proposed parts.js side-power support in the build report.

toeBadge.note: Proposed spec field (parts.js textLabels have no front-face orientation; the black badge plate with white cry baby print is on the toe face +z). The hero page renders it from this field; board integration needs the proposed front-face label support in the build report.

sideSticker.note: Proposed spec field: small white CE / polarity sticker on the right wall, heel-ward of the DC jack (right side view + 3/4, provisional size). Rendered by the hero page.

notes: Dunlop Cry Baby GCB95 wah hero. No knobs and NO LED on the real pedal (verified in all seven references), so led is null and a treadle press toggles nothing. All measured values trace to references/dunlop-crybaby-gcb95_measurements.md; provisional single-view values (DC jack, CE sticker, treadle recess, shell taper) are flagged there and in the field notes above. Deck parts (toe switch) carry no y: they seat by sampling the base profile. The moving set is treadleProfile + padProfile + padDecal, rotating about the pivot field on a press.
